fluff.overview: Manei Domini infantry squads operate in small, heavily augmented formations where every trooper carries cybernetic enhancements tailored to their combat role, from enhanced optics and communicator implants to dermal armor and prosthetic weapon mounts. Domini motorized formations use light vehicles to extend their operational reach while retaining the cybernetic advantages that make each trooper a force multiplier. The vehicles serve primarily as transport to deliver augmented soldiers where they are needed most. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
